title: Lost acknowledgement after external commit
description: Payment/effect may have committed although the response was lost.

title: Idempotency key with missing receipt
description: An idempotency token exists but the authoritative commit receipt is absent.

title: Partial multi-effect commit
description: One member of a two-effect operation committed while the second remains pending.

title: Stale read after committed write
description: A write committed but a stale read makes the target observe the pre-write value.

title: Tool timeout at commit boundary
description: A tool timed out exactly at the point where a remote side effect could have committed.

title: Retryable error emitted after commit
description: The service returned a retryable error after persisting the effect.

title: Duplicate delivery uncertainty
description: The source cannot tell whether a duplicate-delivered command was already applied.

title: Partially committed transaction batch
description: A batch has mixed committed and uncommitted members.

title: Committed effect awaiting compensation
description: The effect committed but the workflow has transitioned to rollback.

title: Authorized but not executed
description: Authorization was granted, but execution never began.

title: Cancellation after dispatch
description: A cancellation raced with dispatch and commit state must be proven.

title: Effect committed under runtime alias
description: The committed effect is recorded under a source-native identifier that differs at target.

title: Receipt belongs to prior execution
description: A valid-looking receipt is for a previous execution of the same workflow.

title: Commit with versioned payload mismatch
description: A committed effect used payload version N while the target proposes N+1.

title: Effect inside completed parallel branch
description: One parallel branch committed an effect before the join migrated.

title: Retry budget available
description: A failed unit still has retry budget and may be attempted again.

title: Retry budget exhausted
description: The maximum retry count has been reached and another attempt is unsafe.

title: Retry after timeout
description: A timeout occurred and retry eligibility depends on whether work committed.

title: Duplicate retry request
description: A retry command was emitted twice across a migration boundary.

title: Partial retry budget consumption
description: The source incremented the retry counter before failing to persist the rest of state.

title: Retry with changed parameters
description: A retry request carries parameters that differ from the failed attempt.

title: Retry after external effect
description: A step failed after an external effect and naive retry could duplicate it.

title: Retry with missing evidence
description: Retry state is not present in transferable history and requires certification.

title: Contradictory retry counters
description: History and certified state disagree on the consumed retry count.

title: Retry with expired authorization
description: The retry budget remains but the authorization window has expired.

title: Retry across runtime identity change
description: The retrying semantic unit has different source and target task identifiers.

title: Retry depends on callback
description: A retry is legal only after an asynchronous callback indicates failure.

title: Retry after compensation
description: The failed operation was compensated and retry legality depends on rollback completion.

title: Retry inside parallel branch
description: Only one failed branch should retry while completed siblings must remain completed.

title: Composite retry obligation
description: A retry is nested under approval and effect-commit obligations.

title: Single pending approval
description: A human approval is pending before the next action.

title: Multi-approver quorum
description: Continuation requires a two-of-three approval quorum.

title: Granted approval not propagated
description: Approval was granted but the source checkpoint predates propagation.

title: Revoked approval
description: A previously granted approval was revoked before migration.

title: Expired approval
description: An approval token expired before the target continuation.

title: Conditional amount approval
description: Approval authority depends on the transaction amount threshold.

title: Delegated approver
description: Approval was delegated and delegation validity must be established.

title: Request changed after approval
description: The approved request was modified after the approval decision.

title: Parallel approval gates
description: Two independent approvals gate different branches before a join.

title: Approval identity alias
description: The approval request is represented by different IDs across runtimes.

title: Approval pending callback
description: A third-party approval callback has not yet arrived.

title: Approval after retry exhaustion
description: Human approval is required to override an exhausted retry budget.

title: Approval before committed effect
description: An approved operation committed just before migration and must not be repeated.

title: Separation-of-duties approval
description: The actor who executes cannot be the actor who approved.

title: Escalated approval path
description: A timed-out approval was escalated to a higher authority.

title: One branch complete, one pending
description: A two-way fork has one completed branch and one unfinished branch.

title: All branches complete, join pending
description: All branches finished but the join node has not executed.

title: Failed branch with compensation
description: A failed branch requires compensation while siblings must remain stable.

title: First-wins race
description: The workflow continues with the first successful branch and cancels others.

title: Parallel branch external effect
description: One branch committed an external effect before its completion marker.

title: Parallel branch retry
description: A failed branch is retrying while sibling results are already final.

title: Dynamic fan-out count
description: The number of spawned branches was computed at runtime.

title: Nested parallel regions
description: An inner parallel region is partially complete inside an outer branch.

title: Branch cancellation
description: One branch was explicitly cancelled before the migration checkpoint.

title: Quorum join
description: The join may fire after a quorum rather than after every branch.

title: Branch identity remapping
description: Source and target runtimes use different identifiers for the same branch.

title: Partial result aggregation
description: Several branch outputs are already folded into an accumulator.

title: Callback-waiting branch
description: One branch waits on an external callback while another is complete.

title: Inconsistent branch snapshot
description: Two snapshot fragments disagree about whether a branch completed.

title: Approval barrier after fork
description: Completed branches cannot join until an approval barrier is satisfied.

title: Mid-iteration pause
description: The workflow pauses after part of an iteration but before its semantic completion.

title: Loop accumulator state
description: Continuation requires preserving an accumulator produced by prior iterations.

title: Maximum iteration boundary
description: The loop is at its maximum bound and must not execute an extra iteration.

title: Break condition satisfied
description: A break predicate became true before migration.

title: Continue condition triggered
description: The current iteration should skip the remaining body and start the next iteration.

title: External effect inside loop
description: A loop iteration committed an effect before the iteration marker was persisted.

title: Retry inside loop
description: The current iteration contains a retrying operation with its own budget.

title: Nested loop indices
description: Two nested loop indices must be preserved without replaying outer work.

title: Loop unit identity alias
description: The target runtime names the loop body differently from the source.

title: Dynamic loop bound
description: The terminal bound is computed from prior workflow data.

title: Callback-driven early termination
description: An external callback requests early loop termination.

title: Per-iteration approval
description: Each iteration requires an approval scoped to its index.

title: Partial iteration commit
description: Some iteration-local state committed while the semantic iteration remains incomplete.

title: Loop after compensation
description: A failed iteration was compensated and loop continuation depends on rollback completion.

title: Loop with parallel body
description: Each loop iteration fans out into parallel branches whose progress must be preserved.

title: Rollback queued after effect
description: A committed effect has a queued but unexecuted compensating action.

title: Partial rollback
description: A multi-step compensation has completed only its first reversal.

title: Failed compensation
description: A compensation attempt failed and may itself require retry policy.

title: Nested saga compensation
description: An inner saga is rolling back while an outer saga remains active.

title: Compensation ordering
description: Rollback must occur in reverse order of committed effects.

title: Retrying compensation
description: The rollback action is in a retry loop with bounded attempts.

title: Uncertain compensating effect
description: A compensation call timed out and may already have applied.

title: Compensation idempotency
description: A compensating action is idempotent only under a specific key.

title: Parallel branch compensation
description: Only failed branches should compensate while successful siblings remain intact.

title: Loop compensation
description: Several loop iterations committed effects and rollback must stop at a known boundary.

title: Approval before destructive rollback
description: A destructive compensation requires explicit human approval.

title: Timeout during rollback
description: A rollback timed out near the external commit boundary.

title: Expired compensation window
description: The rollback time window expired before migration.

title: Compensation identity alias
description: The source and target use different identifiers for the compensating unit.

title: Mixed reversible and irreversible effects
description: Only the reversible subset may be compensated; irreversible effects require escalation.

title: Webhook pending
description: The workflow is waiting for a correlated external webhook.

title: Duplicate callback delivery
description: The same callback may arrive more than once and must be deduplicated.

title: Callback received but unprocessed
description: The callback arrived but its semantic handler has not executed.

title: Callback correlation identity alias
description: Source and target runtimes encode the callback correlation differently.

title: Expired callback
description: The callback validity window expired before continuation.

title: Callback after cancellation
description: A late callback arrives for a workflow action that was cancelled.

title: Callback triggers retry
description: A failure callback authorizes retry of a specific unit.

title: Callback confirms external effect
description: The callback is the authoritative evidence that an effect committed.

title: Multiple callback quorum
description: Continuation requires a quorum of callbacks from independent services.

title: Ordered callbacks
description: Callbacks must be processed in monotonically increasing sequence order.

title: Out-of-order stale callback
description: An older callback arrives after a newer state transition.

title: Invalid callback token
description: A callback carries a token that does not match the active execution.

title: Callback in parallel branch
description: One branch waits for a callback while sibling branches progress.

title: Callback inside loop
description: A callback belongs to one specific loop iteration.

title: Callback after compensation
description: A late success callback arrives after the original action was compensated.

title: Effect plus approval
description: An approved operation may already have committed before the approval acknowledgement migrated.

title: Retry plus callback
description: Retry eligibility depends on a correlated asynchronous failure callback.

title: Parallel plus compensation
description: A failed parallel branch requires rollback while completed siblings must be preserved.

title: Loop plus approval
description: A loop iteration cannot advance until its scoped approval is proven.

title: Effect, retry, and approval
description: A retried approved effect has an uncertain commit boundary.

title: Callback-driven parallel join
description: A callback completes the last outstanding branch before a join.

title: Saga rollback with callback retry
description: Compensation failure waits for a callback before retrying rollback.

title: Nested loop and parallel
description: A loop iteration contains a partially completed fan-out with an accumulator.

title: Approval expiry around effect
description: An approval may have expired after authorization but before effect commit.

title: Cross-runtime identity chain
description: Approval, task, and callback identifiers all change across runtimes.

title: Partial batch with rollback
description: Some batch members committed, one failed, and selected members require compensation.

title: Race, callback, and cancellation
description: A winning callback races with cancellation of losing branches.

title: Retry nested under approval
description: A retry consumes budget only while the associated approval remains current.

title: Compensation with late effect callback
description: A late commit callback arrives after a compensation decision was made.

title: Full obligation stack
description: A workflow combines approval, retry, parallel progress, effect commitment, and callback state.
